headline: Wardens Reclaim Kuura Strand as Battles Rake Palantine and Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Warden forces have consolidated Kuura Strand, securing all six strategic bases following three fresh transitions in two hours around Suosalo and Talven. In Palantine Berm, intense volatility continues unabated, producing five ownership changes within two hours across The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni, leaving the sector divided and one base reduced to neutral ruins. Callahan's Passage has erupted into a ferocious crucible, sustaining more than twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours as Crumbling Post and Scáth Passing endure repeated clashes. In contrast, the frantic base-swapping across Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line has paused over the past two hours, though butcher's bills remain severe, with Weathered Expanse recording over thirty-one thousand total losses on the day. To the west, Mooring County shows sharply accelerating casualty rates as clashes intensify around the lone Colonial holdout at The Wind Hills, while Stlican Shelf remains unresolved after heavy churn around Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town.
